card.name: Drug names in interaction statements
card.fires_on: Linking words like "of" or the inside or end of a drug name, in drug-interaction text where a second drug is about to be named (e.g. dose of buprenorphine, discontinuation of treatment with ketoconazole).

modes.label: "of" before an affected drug
modes.description: The word "of" after dose, concentrations, or discontinuation, right before the named drug.
modes.example: Carefully titrate the dose<< of>> buprenorphine, bup

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A later piece of a drug name in a coadministration or monitoring sentence.
modes.example: Coadministration of amiodar<<one>> with a sofosbuvir-containing

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted tokens are versus/with-type words linking two parties, as in drug-versus-drug pairs.
card.plain: It fires on the small words and drug-name pieces in sentences about one drug affecting another.
